about_the_game:
A simple fighting game distilling the core essence of 3D fighting games! And yet, it's 2D...?

Distilling the essence of 3D fighting games, 2Deez is the perfect starting point, or grinding point, for someone who really wants to understand 3D fighting games as a subgenre.  

Features

  • A story mode with 10 chapters, featuring characters such as a cursed rat, a cotton candy monster, and a cabal of evil wizards

  • Make your own custom palette... with HATS!!!1!!1

  • Arcade Mode

  • Offline Play with Bots

  • Offline Versus Mode for local play

  • Online lobby play with Rollback Netcode, chat, and spectators

  • Replays to watch the games you've played, with replay takeover

  • In-Game command list with frame data

  • An in-depth training mode with hitbox viewer, frame data display, a macro editor, and ability to save training macros to json files

  • If you dig deep, and are willing to work with json files, the ability to make and fight against your own bots
